notes.title: Update v.1.1.0
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the development team of The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily.

It’s been a little while since our last update, but today we’re excited to bring you a new patch featuring user-requested features and key bug fixes.
Thanks as always for your continued feedback and support!


[h3]▼ New Features & System Adjustments[/h3]
We’ve implemented several improvements including full controller support, double speed toggle, and more visibility during battles:

- Added controller support.
- Characters who retreated (HP hit 0) will now still gain experience after a victory.
- Implemented keybind customization options (gamepad not supported).
- Added a “2x Speed” toggle to battle speed options.
- Added a “Squad Details” screen accessible during battles to check unit stats and passive skills.


[h3]▼ Bug Fixes & Additional Tweaks[/h3]
- The Options menu now includes descriptions for each difficulty level at any time.
- Fixed an issue where certain tutorial images became overly pixelated at medium or low graphical settings.
- Fixed a line in the “Unite Episode” between Rubeus and Sapphirus where dialogue meant for Rubeus was mistakenly assigned to Sapphirus.
- Corrected a translation error in “Let's take a look!” where “Duke” was incorrectly displayed as “Baron.”
- In the Squad menu (bottom right), unit names will now auto-adjust spacing when name length exceeds the frame.
- Fixed an issue where only Scarlet and Lily were shown in the unit name display, now all ally units are shown.
- Long comments shown on the top-right of the main screen will now auto-adjust if they exceed the space.


[h3]▼ Playable Demo at TGS 2025![/h3]
We’re thrilled to announce that “The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily” will be playable at Tokyo Game Show 2025!

Thank you so much for all the encouragement and support! This opportunity wouldn’t have been possible without you.

If you’re attending, be sure to visit the One or Eight booth and give it a try!
Other Alliance Arts titles will also be featured so please look forward to it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/6ba01b6b57831436d469fb042509a058c0e7e99f.png[/img]

We’re deeply committed to improving the game based on your feedback and growing it into something even better.
Thank you for continuing to support The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily!

notes.title: Update v.1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the development team of The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily.

Since the launch of the full version, an incredible number of players have played the game, and we’ve been featured as one of the top releases of July 2025.
The entire team is deeply encouraged by this, and it’s all thanks to your warm feedback and support.
We sincerely thank you!

We’re carefully reading all your posts and reviews on the Community Hub, as well as livestreams and videos on social media and various platforms.
(We’re sure Lady Scarlet herself is watching your streams and smiling…!)

Today, we’d like to report on several bug fixes and balance adjustments.


[h3]▼ Fixes and Game Adjustments[/h3]
We received a lot of feedback about the enemies in the final act.
The goal was to create a structure where Scarlet and her allies grow stronger together to overcome overwhelmingly powerful enemies.
However, to enable smoother gameplay, we’ve made slight balance adjustments:

・Increased the number of followers gained after each battle in the final act
・Increased the number of followers gained after the speech event

By increasing public support faster, you can benefit from things like:
“higher starting MP in command battles” & “stronger forces in delegated battles.”
Skills that scale with follower count will also be more useful.

Examples:
- Scarlet’s passive skill “Crimson Banner” now heals more HP
- Lily’s EX skill “On the Stage” now has higher stun success rate
- Scarlet & Lily’s Unison Skill “Hold Me to Thy Bosom” now stuns more reliably

We’ve also made a few other fixes and adjustments:

・Minor animation tweaks to the Prologue tutorial battle
・In Act 2, simply unlocking the bypass route incorrectly triggered the “Great Wall detour” branch — this now happens only when you reach the bypass outpost


[h3]▼ Bug Fixes & Optimization[/h3]

Thank you for your patience. We’ve also carried out bug fixes and optimization.

- Revised memory management to reduce memory usage during gameplay
- Improved loading time when loading save data
- Fixed a progression-blocking issue where units could be placed beyond outpost capacity when Sanjay and Carmine or Primula and Jane joined simultaneously
- Fixed a bug where getting stunned before counterattacking in battle caused no damage and softlocked the game
- Fixed a UI bug where pressing multiple menu buttons at once on the main screen broke the layout
- Fixed issue in some enemy commander defeat scenarios where stats-up dialogs failed to advance
- Fixed an issue where backgrounds did not darken properly during skill enhancement scenes for some enemy commanders
- Fixed a delay in visual effects disappearing when switching from 3D to 2D maps
- Removed unintended frame rate cap settings from language/difficulty options during initial launch
- Fixed incorrect effect positioning for Scarlet & Primula’s Unison skill
- Fixed display issues with ground contact and effects for Uisce & Carmine’s bond skill
- Fixed incorrect camera positioning for Sanjay & Carmine’s Unison Skill
- Fixed temporary narrow FOV bug after Nicol’s panic scene when supply lines are threatened in Act 1
- Replaced the incorrect video for Strategy Dogma “Unit Movement II”
- Fixed Almeria’s skill “Here's the Truth” which stunned for 3 turns instead of the intended 1 turn
- Adjusted line spacing and other typography issues in Simplified Chinese
- Minor fixes to various localized text



We plan to continue releasing multiple updates for the full version, aiming for around September.
However, as we’re concentrating our resources on full version development, the differences with the demo version have become significant.

As a result, we have decided to end public availability of the demo version in order to focus fully on the full version.
We deeply apologize for any inconvenience caused.

We’d love to hear your thoughts and feedback via the Community Hub, reviews, or our official Discord!
(Of course, content creation is also welcome!)

Thank you again for your continued support of The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily!

notes.title: Director's Message: A guide for playing the game
notes.notes:
Hello, this is the development team of The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily.

Thank you so much for waiting...
We’re so happy to announce that we have finally released the full version of the game.
This is entirely thanks to the warm feedback and countless messages of support we’ve received from all of you. We are deeply grateful from the bottom of our hearts.

Today, to mark the release of the full version, we’d like to take the time to once again highlight the game’s features and points of interest.


[h3]▼ Capture every enemy Commanders or Execute them![/h3]
The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily is a [b]turn-based strategy game[/b] where you lead the small rebel force the "Scarlet Army" in a daring challenge against the overwhelming might of the Empire.

Victory in this uphill battle depends on one thing: [b]infiltrating enemy territory swiftly[/b] and [b]capturing or defeating enemy commanders[/b].
This isn’t a game where brute force always wins the day. Instead, your success depends on devising strategies to outmaneuver the enemy using your limited forces.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c3ced6fbd8d293363f5c2963dd67ac6da4393508.jpg[/img]

Will you [b]capture every enemy commander and recruit them[/b] to your cause to clear Scarlet’s name from the false accusation of assassinating the emperor?

Or will you [b]slaughter the commanders[/b] without hesitation, staining your hands with blood as you march toward the path of a Demon Queen?

We will be breaking down the gameplay system of the upcoming full version of the game, and explain some of the elements that may help you in experiencing this strategy game.


[h3]▼Build Supply Lines Against the Empire[/h3]
A key element of this game’s mechanics is the concept of “supply lines.”

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/8100ef2cab716c0661eaa87985a6cb70aa58209a.gif[/img]

- Lines that [b]connect your Headquarters to your occupied outposts[/b] are called [b]supply lines[/b].
- Units stationed on supply lines [b]automatically receive healing (supplies) each turn[/b].

This lets you prepare offensives, hold out in long battles, and adapt your strategy as needed.

As long as an outpost is connected to the Head Quarter, it will [b]recover each turn[/b], 
meaning it is absolutely critical for the Scarlet Army's survival to [b]maintain supply lines[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/2e5d9f8b31d64badd2b6d73e058f0b6195777ea3.jpg[/img]

In other words, this game is all about [b]connecting, extending, and defending supply lines to defeat enemy commanders[/b].

Since the enemy has their own supply lines too, battles become a contest of how to preserve your lines while severing theirs.

This ongoing [b]struggle over supply lines[/b] is one of the core tactical systems in the game.


[h3]▼ You can’t protect everything... So what will you do?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/98f632da523502d9039edaa4aea19382cce892cd.jpg[/img]
You’re constantly outnumbered. 
As your influence spreads, it becomes [b]impossible to defend every outpost[/b].
This is the harsh reality Scarlet faces as the leader of a rebel army.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/1bb32af8d80eb362584401cd6b989c4018b688a2.jpg[/img]

As you see here, you cannot defend all of the supply lines when being attacked from all sides...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/57f9821c0c1eaa65a0a451b3a46c82f66e1e0cfa.gif[/img]

But Scarlet has one powerful advantage. The [b]Stream Airship and Shows[/b].

These allow for powerful strategic effects across the map:
- Stall enemy movement
- Disrupt enemy supply lines
- Boost friendly unit mobility
- Lure enemies into traps
- Flip enemy bases to your side

Use these effects to manipulate enemy movement and secure your supply routes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/e4e83b15ca042b831da71b5e628b850a81ef695f.jpg[/img]

Also, Scarlet and Lily will stream all kinds of bizarre, fun shows from the stream airship, spreading propaganda to shake the morale of enemy troops!


[h3]▼ A War of Lines, Not Land[/h3]
[b]Bases are not your territory, but just a line for supplies[/b]
(There’s no policy management of sorts in this game)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/525e45673becc9a7d3cdd7a33c4b10f676b91cb4.jpg[/img]

Instead of expanding territory indiscriminately, your best bet is to spearhead a direct supply line to your target commander and force a short-term decisive battle.
That’s how the outnumbered Scarlet Army finds a fighting chance against the Empire.

[b]Your tactical choices—which outposts to hold or abandon, who to assign as the strike teams—is the heart of gameplay.[/b]

Anticipate enemy movements, abandon unnecessary posts, and rebuild supply lines to focus fire on the next commander.

This game is [b]not about conquest but a game about strategically capturing or eliminating key targets[/b].


[h3]▼ Delegate (auto-battle) or Command Battle: Your Choice[/h3]
The game progresses [b]taking turns between the enemy phase and the player phase[/b]. When you make contact with an enemy unit, the battle begins.

[b]Enemy turns can be sped up[/b] for smoother pacing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/192414ee2a652acb5a96b3a67aa01eb09b664b0f.jpg[/img]

When a battle begins, you can choose to [b]Delegate (auto-battle) or use Commands (player input)[/b]

Before the battle begins, you'll see a projected damage preview for both sides.
If the expected losses look too high for Delegate, you can take direct command to mitigate risk.
(Note: Auto-battle uses only standard attacks and does not trigger special skills.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/4dac59b38f4775a4a1f6359ff03d76f9d98b3059.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/16b3999b86c7fecb222c820c06173d84e7349636.gif[/img]

[b]If you take direct control, battles play out in a three-turn command battle system.[/b]

Each character learns and upgrades skills (tactics) with RPG-like progression.
As your army grows, [b]what you can do in three turns also expands.[/b]

Because of the three-turn limit, battles against powerful bosses may [b]not be resolved in a single engagement[/b].

That’s where wave attacks using multiple units in succession come into play. 
[b]Who goes in, and in what order[/b], becomes a core strategic decision.

You’ll also find growth and character relationship mechanics, including:
- [b]Leveling up from victories[/b]
- [b]Upgrading your unit size at certain levels[/b]
- [b]Building "trust" between units that fight together repeatedly[/b]

Build enough trust between units, and you’ll unlock special “Unison Skills” and character-specific "Unite Episode".

Befriend (capture) various commanders and enjoy building your own troops.


[h3]▼ Troop Count and Damage Output[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9b03ec3952c56850419485c6290e68566e98da63.jpg[/img]
In this game, each character takes on the role of a [b]unit commander[/b], leading their own squad into battle.

Because of this, as their HP (horde points) decreases, the damage they deal also drops, making it harder to achieve results.

That’s why maintaining strong supply lines and entering battle in peak condition is key to victory for the Scarlet Army.

On the flip side, this also means cutting off enemy supplies and chipping away at their HP will weaken their attacks in turn.

Sever the enemy’s supply lines, and engage their commanders when your forces are at full strength —
Pave your own path to victory with the tactics of a true battlefield strategist!


[h3]▼ What fate awaits the two…?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/c05ebb81653c0d594c16dde2516cbb8ff6ca1e6f.jpg[/img]
This game is [b]multi-ending[/b].

Will Scarlet and Lily choose to capture every enemy commander and bring them over to their side, in order to clear their names of the alleged emperor’s assassination?

Or will they cast aside all allegations and destroy the Empire themselves, without making a single ally?

There are a few other endings as well, but at its core, your choice to [b]capture all or reject them entirely[/b] will greatly impact the fate of the two protagonists.
For your first playthrough, we recommend aiming to either [b]capture everyone or execute everyone[/b], as that will let you fully enjoy the story.

Also, depending on [b]how and when you capture or execute[/b] each enemy commander, the characters' reactions and events will change in subtle ways.

Most of the story (including dialogue scenes) unfolds as a [b]fully voiced drama[/b], so if you enjoy the world, we hope you to try different choices!
(No matter how you play, the story will always move forward so not to worry!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/bae9df67cb8fdc339ccd6003e40b1574b74f4b6a.jpg[/img]

If you’re aiming to capture a specific commander, be sure to check their info screen. [b]Capture conditions are listed in the enemy information[/b], and you can plan your strategy accordingly.

Also, as mentioned in the previous story overview, Scarlet and Lily are [b]a fixed couple[/b] in this game.
(Sorry, there are no branching romance options based on choices)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/8f87f83011187d08400b1db851eb8dbee07d1950.gif[/img]

Instead, the game features a system where certain characters can build trust by [b]fighting and winning together[/b], gradually raising their “Trust Level.”

As Trust Levels grow, the pair will unlock special story episodes (Unite Episode) that explore their unique relationship, and may even learn powerful [b]Unison Skills[/b].

We hope you enjoy building relationships between your units and watching them grow together!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/8b2b865945441a3d1f649938ef118c837c808daa.jpg[/img]

Each character has two Unite Episode partners, and these combinations are listed in the character menu.
(If you try enough, it's possible to view all episodes without replaying the game)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/80b85022e6af956357db513a6a17ad76f0e34d47.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/cd65022d4e327d4c9ded8f796de9a34581c9d83f.gif[/img]

As you progress through these Unite Episodes, powerful Unison Skills will also be unlocked.


[h3]▼ Want a smoother experience?[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/8258b932da86c627a9f7bf097138c5dca7fc6ecf.png[/img]

When you first start the game, or anytime from the options menu, you can freely change the difficulty.

[b]Strategy Mode[/b]
　　A tactical challenge for those who enjoy carefully planning their moves. Great for players familiar with strategy games.

[b]Easy Mode
[/b]A mode designed for those who don’t usually play strategy games, with toned-down enemy stats.

There are no differences in content between difficulty modes, so we hope you’ll choose the one that feels most comfortable for you!



We hope this deep dive has been helpful!
(Sorry it got a bit long again…!)

The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily isn’t your typical land-expanding strategy game.
It’s a strategy game [b]focused on supply lines, and about a small rebel force facing off a massive imperial army[/b].

What kind of battle will Scarlet and Lily fight, and how will their journey end?

[b]Will they find a happy ending, or become feared as Demon Queens——[/b]

Our biggest joy would be for everyone to see the good ending of these two with your own eyes.

Please guide Scarlet and Lily to a happy ending!

We hope for your continued support for
『The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily』

notes.title: Fusing anime with grand strategy, new JRPG The Great Villainess gets early demo
notes.notes:
Anime would seem like fertile ground for grand strategy. The epic space battles of Mobile Suit Gundam could be straight out of Stellaris. The mixture of political intrigue and battleground struggle make Legend of the Galactic Heroes like a Crusader Kings in space. And that's without mentioning the huge number of samurai epics (animated and otherwise) that games like Total War: Shogun have pulled from. But explicitly anime grand strategy games have been few and far between. The Great Villainess: Strategy of Lily borrows freely from both grand strategy and the most tactical JRPGs, making a mix unlike anything you've ever seen before. You can check out a new demo before the game launches in less than a week.

notes.title: Demo Strategy Guide
notes.notes: [h1]The Great Strategy Guide (Act 1)[/h1][h2]Act 1 Overview[/h2][p]Act I's objective is to capture three enemy generals. This guide breaks the Act down into three key steps, each focused on capturing one target.[/p][p][/p][p]➤ Step 1: Advance along the eastern route and capture the first enemy general, Uisce.[/p][p]➤ Step 2: Move north from Uisce’s base, then circle west to capture the second general, Nicol.[/p][p]➤ Step 3: Head north from Nicol’s position. While holding off powerful enemy forces, capture the final general, Geena.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9046c1a6a4910f6767d65b4a47aaa86e8de3ab6f.png"][/img][/p][h2]The Great Strategy Step 1: From Battle Start to Uisce's Encounter[/h2][h3]\[ Basic Strategy ][/h3][p]In Step 1, we will go through the game’s core tactics. [b]The key is to reach the enemy general while maintaining your supply lines, either by stalling or avoiding powerful enemies along the way.[/b][/p][p]The main objective here is to capture Uisce. While there is a more direct route, it’s guarded by a powerful enemy unit. Taking a detour will be the safer approach.[/p][p][/p][h3]① Take the Detour Route to the Right[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/790e3d7d2b021ddb2cdaf6bd065d447f4caf2c8a.png"][/img][/p][p]➤ Avoid heading directly south, the path is blocked by a powerful enemy unit, so taking the longer route around would be safer.[/p][p]➤ Keep Scarlet and Lily together as a team.[/p][p][/p][p]After moving one tile to the top right, enemy forces stationed at the outpost (mountain road) will begin advancing toward the base you just left.[/p][p]On the following turn, return to Dahmlin (your previous position) and take it back.[/p][p]This will trigger an event where you’re “surrounded and unable to move,” after which you’ll gain access to the Stream Airship.[/p][p][/p][h3]② Move the Stream Airship to the Arrow[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/3775c38b721261eefb33b9517e84669a535ef62a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Follow the tutorial instructions to move the Stream Airship. There’s a position where you can stall two bases at once (since the airship’s stall effect can target multiple bases simultaneously, this is a great chance to practice).[/p][p][/p][h3]③ Battles Along the Way[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/771473e654337f8ff271048f5199f82ab96c1e8c.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In small battles before the boss fight, Scarlet’s army generally has the upper hand.[/p][p]Though, preserving HP is crucial, so rather than always using the Delegate combat, commanding battles yourself for better outcomes is recommended.[/p][p][/p][p]➤ Scarlet’s AOE skill “[b]Crimson Wave[/b]” is excellent for wiping out enemies.[/p][p]➤ Use Lily’s “[b]Opening Call[/b]” to boost the defense of allies who are likely to be attacked.[/p][p][/p][p]When a base has 2 or more durability (★), you can't advance until you reduce all stars. One ★ is reduced per turn, so capturing a 2★ base takes two turns. [/p][p][/p][h3]④ Switch to Capture Stream[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/a43e63409c09af1706814c86057d2009529fdc23.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Once you’ve captured the base in front of Uisce’s, switch the Stream Airship to Capture Stream and advance your units.[/p][p]During this time, you won’t be able to stall enemies, so it’s possible that enemy forces will infiltrate your bases like Dahmlin. But don’t worry, as long as you capture Uisce, you’ll win the map.[/p][p]Since Capture Stream consumes no energy, keep it active as you move in to capture Uisce.[/p][p][/p][h3]⑤ The Battle Against Uisce[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/bed2f5c80fdaab9652a9e618aec51c17b4c51884.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Uisce is a powerful infantry, which has an advantage over Scarlet who is a cavalry unit.[/p][p][/p][p]➤ Use Lily’s “Opening Call” to boost Scarlet’s defense, and focus on dealing damage using “Crimson Wave,” which doesn’t trigger counterattacks.[/p][p]➤ It’s fine if you can’t defeat him in one battle, recover HP via supply lines and use Scarlet’s “Crimson Among Men” skill to sustain.[/p][p][/p][p]Once Uisce’s HP turns red and “Capture!” appears under the name, use Lily’s skill “On the Stage” to capture her.[/p][p][/p][h3]⑥ Using Uisce as an Ally[/h3][p]Uisce is a high-crit character with a powerful EX skill that deals major damage to single targets.[/p][p]➤ EX Skill: "Fox Hunting"[/p][p]・A powerful 1.8x single-target damage.[/p][p]・Deals a guaranteed extra 200 damage. A reliable damage source.[/p][p]➤ “Updated Observations”[/p][p]・Increases the attack power of allied units.[/p][p]➤ “Hometown Hero”[/p][p]・While limited to Elysia, it speeds up base occupation by 1.[/p][p]➤ “Guerrilla Warfare”[/p][p]・On turn 3, boosts crit damage for allied infantry and artillery.[/p][p]・Can create synergy with ally units.[/p][p][/p][h2]The Great Strategy Step 2: Capturing Nicol[/h2][h3]\[ Basic Strategy ][/h3][p]Step 2 features Nicol as the enemy general. With Uisce joining your army, you’ll now be able to advance with 3 units.[/p][p]Hold the frontline with Uisce while Scarlet and Lily flank from the side to cut off enemy supply lines.[/p][p][/p][h3]① Move Uisce Near Nicol’s Base[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/6aada11d48141201fa2a7fa4b2d3e9e1dff7ce08.png"][/img][/p][p]After capturing Uisce, turns continue. If Scarlet and Lily already acted during his capture, only Uisce can move.[/p][p]Send Uisce near Nicol’s base.[/p][p]Nicol won’t initiate combat against Uisce, so have Uisce hold the line while Scarlet and Lily advance along a detour.[/p][p][/p][h3]② Flank With Scarlet and Lily to Sever Supply Lines[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/563a9efecbba30db9b892f974326ec30a666a7e9.png"][/img][/p][p]While Uisce holds the frontline, move Scarlet and Lily along the marked path to cut off enemy supplies.[/p][p]You can rush straight to the next base or capture bases along the way and increase their durability (★).　[/p][p]Some small enemy units will target Uisce, so you could use this to farm experience and level up.[/p][p][/p][h3]③ A.C.E.[/h3][p]Arriving at the Elysia Customs Gate triggers an event. A powerful enemy unit called "A.C.E." spawns at Geena’s base.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9c11314cbc2d57e110f774f62a1d6cc6b357e677.png"][/img][/p][p]A.C.E. patrols a specific route and won’t advance toward Nicol’s position, so ignore it for now.[/p][p][/p][h3]④ Head South and Capture Nicol[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/3dfc121b45d131d49f3a8b9a67bd3729d1796f91.jpg"][/img][/p][p]While heading south, stall weaker enemies coming from the north and advance to Nicol’s base.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9e1db06ac7014aa8f757f02aceea2f1e60cd2763.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Nicol is a strong infantry commander, so he has an edge over Scarlet. Use “Opening Call” to strengthen Scarlet’s defenses.[/p][p]Nicol will use skills to reduce your party’s defense and mobility at the start of battle. If you’re fighting a group, Scarlet’s “Crimson Wave” is great for damaging them all at once.[/p][p]Meanwhile, have Lily who has advantage against infantry, focus on steadily chipping away Nicol’s HP.[/p][p]Even if you can’t win in one go, two to three battles should push Nicol’s HP into the red.[/p][p][/p][h3]⑤ Capture Nicol Using the Stream Airship[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/ba3b6a64a34ae83e2634170e822a5172f486156d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]When Nicol is weakened, move the Stream Airship over his base and switch to Capture Stream to capture him.[/p][p]In some cases, you may capture her while defending a base.[/p][p]But this is only possile if Capture Stream is active on that tile. [/p][p][/p][p]Even if you capture Nicol, he will only join you as a unit AFTER you capture Geena. Time you attacks and try to acquire both characters.[/p][p][/p][h2]The Great Strategy Step: Capturing Geena[/h2][h3]\[ Basic Strategy ][/h3][p]The key in the Geena fight is avoiding A.C.E.[/p][p]Understand its movement pattern and use Stalling Stream wisely to gain the upper hand.[/p][p]Here’s the general route after the Nicol fight. If enemies have occupied other bases, you could reclaim them before heading to Geena, if you want.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/1858a6bfc83e0b564ba4b2465ee112dbb422792c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]① Stall A.C.E. and Move Toward Geena’s Base[/h3][p]A.C.E. patrols four bases in a clockwise loop and only attacks if the player's unit is in its way.[/p][p]Take the northern, U-shaped route to Geena’s position.[/p][p]If you can stall A.C.E. at Position ① on the map below, you can easily attack Geena's base.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9c11314cbc2d57e110f774f62a1d6cc6b357e677.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Tips: Do I need to fight A.C.E.?[/h3][p]A.C.E. offers boss-level EXP, but they are extremely strong.[/p][p]Early in the game, your forces are too weak to reliably defeat it, so it’s not necessary to fight them.[/p][p][/p][h3]② The Battle Against Geena[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/e932e5b7e4963888774b6a88b0719e9d67a84f40.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Geena is an artillery unit who buffs enemy defense and debuffs the player's attack. Her passive also reduces cavalry attack and mobility on turn 1—bad news for Scarlet.[/p][p]She is backed by three escort units and is difficult to capture in one battle.[/p][p]Use Scarlet’s “Crimson Wave” in the first two turns to eliminate small fry, then target Geena on turn 3.[/p][p]Support her with other allies for best results.[/p][p]Use Uisce’s “Updated Observations” to boost Scarlet’s power further.[/p][p]When Geena’s HP is red, move the Stream Airship and capture her.[/p][p][/p][h3]Out of Stream Airship Energy?[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44445075/9c11314cbc2d57e110f774f62a1d6cc6b357e677.png"][/img]If the battle against Geena drags on and you can no longer stall A.C.E., time your moves and circle back clockwise.[/p][p]Make sure to always stall A.C.E. at Position ① only.[/p]
